verdict.rationale: A business-registry agency could plausibly publish an API spec, XML schemas, or a bulk-data dictionary, so the axis applies. The evidence shows none: every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and the WyoBiz probe found no documented public API. The rest of the pack covers web wizards, PDF filings, and an authorized-user UCC e-filing system, with no published schema or data dictionary.
